# has sensory observation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasSensoryObservation`](gmeow-hasSensoryObservation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasSensoryObservation>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sensory`](../../slices/sensory.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Links an entity to a sensory observation that measured one of its properties. Non-functional: multiple sensors may observe the same property of the same entity, and those readings coexist without collapse ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) -> [`gmeow:SensoryObservation`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryObservation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasSensoryObservation`](gmeow-hasSensoryObservation.md) from [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) to [`gmeow:SensoryObservation`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryObservation.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
